title: Diamond Vault Account: Exclusive events and benefits
summary: This document explains Diamond Vault Account benefits: invitations to exclusive, curated business gatherings (strategic finance, market insights, peer networking) with limited availability, plus partnered estate and succession planning services at a 22% discount. It details redemption steps: request a partner referral via your banker, confirm eligibility, share account details during scheduling, and retain engagement confirmations.
